name: app-nunito-typography-scale-curved-path-sheet
title: Nunito Type Scale on a Curved Path
whatItIs: A tall lavender sheet with a giant indigo 'NUNITO' wordmark, weight labels (Regular, Bold, Extra Bold) on pills, a curved dashed path of numbered circles from 14 to 28 showing the size scale, faint alphabet and numerals, and challenge/solution cards.
whatItMeans: Turning a type scale into a curved journey makes documentation playful, while the enormous rounded letters show off the typeface's friendliness.
techniques: Type scale plotted as a path of growing circles
Weight names pinned to the word as floating pills
Alphabet and numerals ghosted in the background
Gigantic specimen in a single accent colour

vocabulary.definition: A set of sizes used in an interface, such as 14, 16, 18, 20.
A showcase of a typeface's forms.
A small label naming a typeface weight.
